description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing media key capabilities, including creation, access, and querying supported key systems and versions within the Rialto client namespace.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media keys capabilities interface, providing methods to retrieve supported key systems and check support for specific key systems.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the media keys capabilities IPC interface, throws if creation fails.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Destructor that resets the IPC interface.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
